claims.sentence: You can apply for credit transfer if you are a student enrolled in the main professional educational programs at the university, or if you are a parent or legal representative of a minor student

The university recognizes results of study, including subjects, courses, disciplines (modules), practice, and additional educational programs, that you completed at other educational organizations or within the university itself
You must submit a written application and documents that confirm your previous study results
The required documents include an education or qualification certificate, including those issued in a foreign country
or a training document such as a study certificate, a certificate of study period, or a document issued by a foreign organization
If you are applying for results completed inside the university, the attestation commission uses the records already entered in your electronic grade book
The application forms are listed in Appendix 1 and Appendix 2 of the regulation
You may submit the application and documents in the forms specified in the regulation

The application form for students begins with a heading to the Chairman of the Attestation Commission, followed by your full name, study group, and study group code, and the text continues beyond the provided excerpt
You must submit your application and supporting documents to the university's attestation commission
The standard deadline is no later than 14 (четырнадцати) календарных дней before the start of the semester or trimester
If you are a first-year student in your first semester or trimester, you must submit the application no later than 14 (четырнадцати) календарных дней after the start of your studies
If you participated in an academic mobility program, you must submit the application no later than 3 (трех) рабочих дней after the completion of that program

The attestation commission evaluates your application by comparing the planned learning outcomes of the relevant part of your current educational program with the study results you have already achieved
The university grants credit only when it establishes a correspondence between your previous results and your current program requirements
To establish this correspondence, the commission may conduct an assessment of your actual achievement of the planned learning outcomes
The matching procedure involves comparing your confirmation documents with the planned outcomes for the corresponding part of your program
The commission may analyze information about the educational program from the issuing organization's official website or request information directly from that organization
If you submit training documents from foreign organizations, you must provide a Russian translation
The university may send requests to the issuing organizations to verify the authenticity of your training documents

If you submit education or qualification certificates from foreign countries, you must provide a Russian translation in a legalized form along with a certificate of recognition of foreign education, unless Russian legislation or an international treaty exempts you from this requirement
When granting credit for training results from foreign countries, the commission conducts an assessment according to the regulation's procedures
The commission also considers the specific credit unit calculation system of the foreign educational organization and may compare credit units with the volume of contact and independent work
The regulation does not specify the exact submission methods (e.g., online portal, in-person, email) beyond stating that applications can be submitted in the forms indicated in the regulation
", so the full form structure and additional fields are not provided
